title: Nested watched roots share inotify watches: re-watch the neighbours after an unwatch
rule: If two watched roots can nest, unwatching one must re-watch every still-active root that contains it or lies inside it (outer first). notify's inotify backend keeps one watch per folder, shared by nested roots, and `unwatch` drops every watch under the path; Windows and macOS keep separate per-root watches, so the bug shows only on Linux. Test it: pause the outer root and remove the inner one, then assert a new file under the inner folder is indexed within the latency criterion.
rationale: E2.5 (#48): pausing or removing one of two nested sources silently stopped events for the other on Linux until the hourly rescan.
